title: can you tell i love @Swept Away: A New Musical & @Creative Goods Merc...
transcript: I got a package! two hours ago I would have told you I don't know what it is and then I saw that Sydney posted it and now I do know what it is I'm even more excited there's no one doing better merch on the planet than creative goods ready swept away! dear sailor our musical Swept Away is heading to Broadway in the fall we are beyond excited and hope to see you there from the Avett Brothers this is so cute I am obsessed with this art like I think it is the most beautiful art on Broadway maybe I saw it down in DC I love it oh this is so cute i’m gonna be so annoying about this show uh the banjo stop I have thought about this production so much I can't wait for it to come to broadway and I can't wait to talk about it with all of you if you can I would say avoid all swept away spoilers I was shocked and I think that is the best way to be thank you so much I'm gonna wear this every single day it's so soft creative good they never miss
